title: Context Selection Budget
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI for EE Research
description: Budgeting activity in which learners give each of nine candidate context items the verdict include, compress, or omit for the task of checking whether a draft's reported ENOB is consistent with its measurement procedure. A running total is kept against a 6,500-token context budget (8,000-token window minus a 1,500-token completion reserve); over-budget submissions are refused, and the one accepted submission is scored out of 9 with the correct verdict and reason for every item. All numbers are illustrative.

educational.topic: Context selection and compression under a token budget
learningObjectives: Prioritize nine candidate context items for a stated task by assigning each one the verdict include, compress, or omit, so that the total fits a stated token budget and at least 8 of 9 verdicts match the answer key
Apply the test "would the answer change if this item were missing?" to decide what enters the context window
prerequisites: Context window, context selection, summarization, context compression, and conversation history
The shared budget of prompt and completion tokens

accessibility.notes: describe() provides a screen-reader description; all controls are native HTML buttons and drop-down lists reachable with the Tab key and activated with Enter or Space; meaning is carried by words and symbols (check mark, X, filled and open circles, the ▶ selection marker) as well as by a blue/orange color-blind-safe palette; body text is 16 px, with 14 px only for footnotes and meter labels.

controls.label: Item
controls.purpose: Chooses which of the nine items the verdict buttons act on.

controls.label: Include
controls.purpose: Gives the selected item the verdict Include; it adds its size as is to the running total.

controls.label: Compress
controls.purpose: Gives the selected item the verdict Compress; enabled only for items that list a compressed size, which it adds to the total.

controls.label: Omit
controls.purpose: Gives the selected item the verdict Omit; it adds 0 tokens.

controls.label: Submit
controls.purpose: Enabled when all nine items have a verdict. Refused with "Over budget by n tokens. Compress or omit something." when the total exceeds 6,500; otherwise scores the one submission.

controls.label: Next Page
controls.purpose: Shown after submission when the item feedback does not fit on one page; pages through it.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Constrained prioritization with a live running total, a refusal rule at the budget, and explanatory feedback after one scored submission
keyQuestions: Would the answer change if this item were missing?
Which items can be compressed without losing what the task needs?
What does including an irrelevant document cost?
commonMisconceptions: A large irrelevant document is harmless if it fits
Summarizing history is optional because the model remembers the conversation
assessmentOpportunities: At least 8 of 9 verdicts matching the answer key, with the total within the 6,500-token budget, is evidence of mastery
Learner explains why the related-work section alone pushes an otherwise correct selection over the budget
